headline: Colombia Stocks Fall and Peso Depreciates Ahead of Central Bank Decision
summary: Colombia's COLCAP index declined 0.63% to 2,489.93 while the peso dropped about 0.5% to 3,167 per dollar, ahead of the central bank's upcoming monetary policy rate decision.
why: Banco de la Republica interest rate moves directly affect debt servicing costs and currency stability in Colombia's economy.

impacts.name: Colombian Peso
impacts.why: Cautious market positioning ahead of interest rate decisions frequently depresses local currency valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
